sentences.text: Chicago -LRB- -LSB- ʃᵻˈkɑːɡoʊ -RSB- or -LSB- ʃᵻˈkɔːɡoʊ -RSB- -RRB- , officially the City of Chicago , is the third-most populous city in the United States .	City	City	third-most populous city	List of United States cities by population	United States	United States

With over 2.7 million residents , it is also the most populous city in both the state of Illinois and the Midwestern United States .	Illinois	Illinois	United States	United States	state	U.S. state	Midwestern United States	Midwestern United States
It is the county seat of Cook County .	Cook County	Cook County, Illinois	Cook	Cook County, Illinois	county seat	county seat

The Chicago metropolitan area , often referred to as Chicagoland , has nearly 10 million people and is the third-largest in the U.S. Chicago has been called a global architecture capital .	Chicago metropolitan area	Chicago metropolitan area
In terms of wealth and economy , Chicago is considered one of the most important business centers in the world .

Chicago was incorporated as a city in 1837 , near a portage between the Great Lakes and the Mississippi River watershed , and grew rapidly in the mid-nineteenth century .	portage	Chicago Portage	Great Lakes	Great Lakes	Mississippi River watershed	Mississippi watershed

Positioned along Lake Michigan , the city is an international hub for finance , commerce , industry , technology , telecommunications , and transportation : O'Hare International Airport is the second-busiest airport in the world when measured by aircraft traffic ; the region also has the largest number of U.S. highways and rail road freight .	Lake Michigan	Lake Michigan	O'Hare International Airport	O'Hare International Airport	busiest airport in the world when measured by aircraft traffic	World's busiest airports by aircraft movements

In 2012 , Chicago was listed as an alpha global city by the Globalization and World Cities Research Network , and ranked seventh in the world in the 2016 Global Cities Index .	Globalization and World Cities Research Network	Globalization and World Cities Research Network	Global Cities Index	Global cities#Global Cities Index

Chicago has the third-largest gross metropolitan product in the United States -- about $ 640 billion according to 2015 estimates .	United States	United States	gross metropolitan product	gross metropolitan product
The city has one of the world 's largest and most diversified economies with no single industry employing more than 14 % of the workforce .

In 2016 , Chicago hosted over 54 million domestic and international visitors , a new record making it one of the top visited cities in the nation .	top visited cities in the nation	Tourist attractions in the United States

Landmarks in the city include Millennium Park , Navy Pier , the Magnificent Mile , Art Institute of Chicago , Museum Campus , the Willis -LRB- Sears -RRB- Tower , Museum of Science and Industry , and Lincoln Park Zoo .
